'''Raquid Krev''' was a cargo hauler who owned and operated the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Lexus Primal]]'' during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Krev once had a cargo of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] stolen by a group of [[spice-jacker]]s. One of their members disguised himself as Raquid through the use of a [[Holographic Projector Doubler Suit]], and overrode the programming of Krev's [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]], [[D-Mot]].
